title: Agent guidance lifecycle operation result
description: Structured result of a bounded agent-guidance lifecycle query or mutation.

operation_id.description: Agent-guidance operation that produced this result.

mutation_applied.description: Whether the requested lifecycle mutation changed durable state.

guidance_id.description: Stable identifier of the primary guidance record in the result.

store.description: Guidance store selected by the lifecycle authority.

record.description: Primary guidance record returned by the operation.

records.description: Guidance records returned by a query or multi-record mutation.

mutation_receipt.description: Revision-bound receipt for an applied or replayed mutation.

failures.description: Structured failures that prevented or bounded the operation.
